answer: Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 4 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the river check. Bindings are kept in marble, verified in delta, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, and thus it has to store and read state per alias. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 3 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
